name: Krypton Industries Limited
about: Krypton Industries Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells polyurethane (PU) tyres in India. It operates through three segments: Tyre, Rim and Wheels; Footwear; and Hospital Equipments. The company offers PU tyres for bicycles, push carts, and wheelchairs, as well as for rehabilitation, agricultural, and industrial equipment. It also provides tubeless tyres, commode chairs, and PU shoe soles and sandals/chappals; and trades in tubeless tyres, wheel chairs, accessories, walkers, cycle accessories, plastic rims, crutches, rollators, etc. The company sells its products through a network of dealers and distributors. It also exports its products to Australia, Africa, the Middle East, Europe, North America, and internationally. The company was incorporated in 1990 and is headquartered in Kolkata, India.
